hooks.command: cmd=$(echo $TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(scripts/train\.py|scripts/eval\.py|scripts/run_sweep\.py|scripts/generate_)' && [ ! -f '.epm-authorized' ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Experiment commands must run through /issue. Create a task first: `uv run python scripts/task.py new --kind experiment --title "..."`, then use /issue <N> where N is the printed task number.' >&2; exit 1; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'ssh +epm-issue-[0-9]+ +.*git +pull'; then if [ -n "$(cd /home/thomasjiralerspong/explore-persona-space && git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'WARNING: ssh + git pull on a pod with dirty local tree. Local has uncommitted changes — pulling on the pod creates divergent states. Commit/stash locally before pulling on the pod.' >&2; fi; fi

file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$file_path" ] && echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '^/workspace/'; then echo "WARNING: Editing $file_path under /workspace/. CLAUDE.md: 'All code changes on local VM, never on pods.' Likely a stale symlink or misconfigured clone — fix the path." >&2; fi

a=$(printf '%s' "${EPM_AUTONOMOUS_SESSION:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); if [ -n "$a" ] && [ "$a" != "0" ] && [ "$a" != "false" ] && [ "$a" != "no" ]; then q=$(jq -c '.tool_input' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$q" | grep -qiE 'approve plan|plan #[0-9]|/tasks/[0-9]+/plan|plan v[0-9]+'; then echo 'BLOCKED (autonomous session): a plan-approval AskUserQuestion is forbidden when EPM_AUTONOMOUS_SESSION is set. The plan-approval decision is code-enforced by `task.py set-status <N> plan_pending --auto-approve-if-autonomous --gpu-hours <X>` (issue SKILL.md Step 2b): under the GPU-hour cap the status is already approved (continue to Step 4); over cap or with a blank estimate it is parked at plan_pending with epm:awaiting-spend-approval (EXIT). Re-read the task status and act on it; do NOT ask the user.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi

file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); if [ -n "$file_path" ] && echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then cd /home/thomasjiralerspong/explore-persona-space && uv run ruff check --fix --quiet "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; uv run ruff format --quiet "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; fi
